subject: general
question: If each of the observations of 14, 22, 16, 24, 12, 8, 4, 18, 12, 10 is increased by 10, then what will be their new mean?
solution:
Given:

Scores = 14, 22, 16, 24, 12, 8, 4, 18, 12, 10.

Each observation is increased by 10.

Formula Used:

Mean = (sum of all the values)/(total no. of values)

Calculations:

⇒ M = (24 + 32 + 26 + 34 + 22 + 18 + 14 + 28 + 22 + 20)/(10)

⇒ M = 240/10 = 24.

∴ The new arithmetic mean will be 24.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

If we increase each value of the observation by a certain number then the average will also increase by that certain number.

So the mean of the initial observations is 14. now we are increasing the value of each observation by 10 so the average will also increase by 10 so the answer is 14 + 10 = 24.
